entities.summary: The Getae-Dacian civilisation, King Burebista's unification of Dacian tribes (82–44 BCE), the mountain fortresses of the Orăștie Mountains (UNESCO), and King Decebalus's resistance to Roman expansion culminating in the Dacian Wars (101–106 CE).
